title: Women Are Sacred 2027:
headline: Three days that give you tools, peers and people who understand the work.
story: This teaser answers “what will I get out of going?” The honest answer: practical tools, learning from each other, culture at the center, and time with people who get it.
Four quick chapters, one text card each, then the widest, warmest room. Show the substance of the gathering. Never cut it like a party or a trip.
do: Open cold on a session moment, hook text on frame 1.
Keep the four chapter cards in one position and weight.
Show hands making something for the culture chapter.
Handle culture and ceremony with care. Leave out anything private.
Crop out any “Specialty Institute” sign in Durham shots.
dont: No logo, title card or fade at 0:00.
No old WAS lockup (two women holding hands), even in the background.
No images of harm or fear. No red handprint. No statistics.
Never “Four days”. The 2027 conference is three days.
No slow-mo novelty framing of ceremony.
